title: Browser support policy
description: Authoritative declaration of the browser matrix the production build promises to run on (issue #153). The browserslist production query, the polyfill decision, and the README matrix are all reconciled against this file by `make check-browser-support`.

polyfill.description: RSBuild `output.polyfill` mode the production build must declare.

baseline.description: Human-readable name of the interoperability line the floors were chosen from.

queries.description: Exact, ordered `browserslist.production` query list in package.json.

families.description: Browserslist family id to the floor the resolution must produce.

floor.description: Lowest supported version. Required unless the family is latest-only.

trackLatest.description: Browserslist tracks a single always-current version for this family, so no floor can be pinned.

readmeSection.description: README heading whose table must list every family and floor.
